summary: The agent implements a highly sophisticated solution with robust feature engineering (including TF-IDF, SVD, and out-of-fold target encoding) and cross-validation. However, it suffers from critical data leakage by fitting TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, frequency encodings, and group aggregations on the combined train and test datasets. Additionally, it relies solely on a single evaluation metric (RMSE).
